quote: We are happy to introduce AI Performance in Bing Webmaster Tools, a new set of insights that shows how publisher content appears across Microsoft Copilot
owner_action: Verify the site in Bing Webmaster Tools, open AI Performance and export citations, cited pages and grounding queries each month.

quote: The branded queries filter is now available to all eligible sites.
owner_action: In the Search Console Performance report, apply the branded and non-branded filter and read the two groups separately.

quote: New agentic browsing category added to default config
owner_action: Make /llms.txt answer 200 or 404, never a server error: Lighthouse flags server errors on it and marks a 404 Not Applicable.

quote: Google Analytics now provides a dedicated way to measure and analyze traffic originating from popular AI assistants.
owner_action: Open the Default Channel Group in GA4 reports, check that the AI Assistant channel shows, and add a custom rule only for AI referrers that still land in Referral.

quote: we're excited to announce the launch of new Search Generative AI performance reports in Search Console
owner_action: Open the Generative AI performance report in Search Console and read AI impressions by page, country and device.

source_name: Google Search Central Blog (note added to the 3 June post)
quote: As of August 31, 2026, we've rolled out these insights to all websites worldwide.
owner_action: Check the Generative AI performance report is now visible for every property, in every country you serve.

source_name: Search Console Help: Search generative AI control
quote: As of August 31, 2026, we’ve rolled out this control to all websites worldwide.
owner_action: Open Settings > Search generative AI in Search Console and confirm each property is set to include the site, unless the owner chose otherwise.

quote: La Recherche Google franchit une étape majeure aujourd’hui en France avec le lancement des Aperçus IA (AI Overviews) et du Mode IA (AI Mode).
owner_action: Read the French AI impressions in the Generative AI performance report and check which French questions now show an AI Overview.

quote: while these files aren't needed for Google Search (and won't negatively or positively impact your visibility or rankings)
owner_action: Keep llms.txt optional: publish it for other tools if wanted, but do not expect Google Search visibility from it.

quote: Added a new guide on optimizing for generative AI features on Search.
owner_action: Read Google's guide on optimizing for generative AI features, its 'AEO/GEO' mythbusting section first, before paying for an AI-specific fix.

quote: Clarified that our spam policies also apply to generative AI responses in Google Search.
owner_action: Do not publish mass-produced or deceptive pages meant to win AI citations: Google's spam policies now say they cover AI responses too.

quote: The preferred sources feature is starting to roll out to AI Overviews and AI Mode.
owner_action: If the site publishes articles or news, check it in Google's source preferences tool and add the preferred-source button; the site must be included in Search generative AI features.

quote: Googlebot currently fetches up to 2MB for any individual URL (excluding PDFs).
owner_action: Keep each page's HTML under 2MB and put the title, canonical and key structured data near the top; move heavy inline CSS and JavaScript to external files.

quote: This feature will no longer appear in Google Search starting May 7, 2026.
owner_action: Stop treating FAQPage markup as a way to win an FAQ rich result in Google Search; the result no longer appears.

quote: we are excited to introduce Search Console reporting for web multimodal search, in the report for performance on Search results
owner_action: In the Search Console performance reports, use the new multimodal search type filter to see visits that began with an image search (Lens, Circle to Search) and export them.

quote: It is called Topics Portfolio, and it groups the grounding queries where your site appears into broader thematic clusters
owner_action: In Bing Webmaster Tools open AI Performance > Topics Portfolio and read Top Opportunity Queries: topics where other sites are cited and yours is not.
